description: Calculate the full upfront cost of purchasing a Singapore residential property (HDB or private resale), with each cost line attributed to its funding source (cash, CPF or bank loan). Returns option fee, exercise fee, stamp duties (BSD and ABSD), downpayment breakdown, and a sufficiency check against available funds.

availableCash.description: Cash the buyer can put towards the purchase, in SGD; checked in `cashSufficiency`.

availableCpfOA.description: CPF Ordinary Account balance the buyer can put towards the purchase, in SGD; checked in `cpfSufficiency`.

buyerType.description: Residency or legal status of the buyer; sets the ABSD rate.

cpfFirst.description: When true, fund CPF-eligible costs from a single CPF pool capped at availableCpfOA (CPF first, remainder cash), overriding the per-item cash/cpf funding sources. ABSD stays cash.

existingPropertiesOwned.description: Residential properties the buyer already owns; sets the ABSD tier.

legalFeeFunding.description: Pay the legal/conveyancing fee from cash or from CPF.

legalFeeOverride.description: Legal/conveyancing fee to use instead of the standard estimate ($2,000 HDB, $3,000 private), in SGD.

loanAmount.description: Bank loan amount, in SGD. Takes precedence over `ltv`; with neither, a 75% loan is assumed.

ltv.description: Loan as a fraction of the purchase price (e.g. 0.75 = 75%). Used only when loanAmount is omitted.

minimumCashPercent.description: Minimum cash component as a percentage of price: 5 or 10 on a first housing loan, 25 with one already outstanding.

propertyType.description: Whether this is an HDB resale flat or a private property; sets the option and exercise fees, default legal and valuation fees, and stamp-duty funding.

purchasePrice.description: Agreed purchase price, in SGD; fees, stamp duties and downpayment follow from it.

stampDutyFunding.description: Pay the stamp duties (BSD and ABSD) from cash or from CPF. Omit for the usual convention: HDB pays BSD from CPF, private from cash, and ABSD is paid in cash.

valuationFeeOverride.description: Override for valuation fee, in SGD. Defaults to $120 (HDB) or $350 (private).

name: calculate_purchase_cost

absd.description: Additional Buyer's Stamp Duty, in SGD.

absdRate.description: ABSD rate applied as a decimal (e.g. 0.2 = 20%).

cashRequired.description: Total cash required across all cash-funded items, in SGD.

fundingSource.description: Where this cost is funded from.

cpfRequired.description: Total CPF required across all CPF-funded items, in SGD.

balanceInCash.description: Remaining downpayment funded by additional cash, in SGD.

balanceMandatoryCash.description: Balance of mandatory cash after option + exercise fees, in SGD.

cpfDownpayment.description: CPF portion of downpayment, in SGD.

minimumCash.description: Minimum cash portion of price, in SGD.

totalCost.description: Total cost: price + all fees + stamp duties, in SGD.

title: Purchase cost & funding breakdown
